{{Quote|We don't care what you do, just get us off this planet. We'll cooperate, just save us&hellip;|Judder Page, to [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] troopers|<ref name="HttE" />}}
'''Hettsk''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was victorious over the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in a large-scale [[Battle of Hettsk|battle]] fought on Hettsk. During the battle, two [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilots]] were shot down over the planet, and after an Imperial [[Scout/Legends|recon]] team had retrieved them from an area of [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]], the New Republic [[Katarn Commandos]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit [[Mission to Hettsk|rescued]] the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].

==Description==
Hettsk was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="HttE" /> situated in the [[Hettsk system/Legends|Hettsk system]], a part of the [[Belsmuth sector/Legends|Belsmuth sector]]<ref name="EAOC Hettsk" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC Hettsk" /> Its surface featured dense, uninhabited [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]].<ref name="HttE" />

==History==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], as part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="TEA" /> a large-scale [[Space warfare/Legends|space]] and [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] [[Battle of Hettsk|battle]] was fought on Hettsk, with the Empire emerging victorious<ref name="HttE" /> and the planet being situated in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] either conquered by or allied with [[Thrawn's confederation]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the battle, two New Republic [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[New Republic pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Wing Commander/Legends|Wing Commander]] [[Greni]] and [[Bross]], were shot down over Hettsk's jungle.<ref name="HttE" />

[[File:Lieutenant-page.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Lieutenant Judder Page (pictured) led the Katarn Commandos on a mission to Hettsk.]]
In response, an Imperial [[Scout/Legends|recon]] team consisting of a [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]] was dispatched from the [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] established in Hettsk's [[City/Legends|population center]] to the crash site to capture the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. Since the dense [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] had impeded the Imperials' progress, they made camp in the jungle to spend the [[Local day/Legends|night]].<ref name="HttE" />

By that time, however, the New Republic's elite [[Katarn Commandos]] [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit had caught up with the Floating Fortress on a [[Mission to Hettsk|mission]] to retrieve the pilots. To make the Floating Fortress open its hatch, the [[Commando/Legends|commandos']] [[Commanding officer/Legends|leader]],<ref name="HttE" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], and two of the team's members, [[Frorral/Legends|Frorral]] and [[Idow]], pretended to surrender to the [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] standing watch over the camp, begging to be taken off Hettsk. The Katarn Commandos subsequently overpowered the Imperial [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and rescued the pilots, departing for a New Republic [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]].<ref name="HttE" />

==Locations==
A population center was located on Hettsk, on the far side of the planet from an area of uninhabited jungle. The Galactic Empire established garrisons in the population center.<ref name="HttE" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Hettsk first appeared in "[[Commando Mission]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1992]] ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="HttE" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Hettsk [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet itself, in grid square P-6.<ref name="TEA" />
